parts.label: (a)
parts.text:

for the fashion show.

Jacob and Jyoti considered possible sources of finance for the fashion show. Their options
were:
• bank overdrafts
• crowdfunding
• friends and family.
Evaluate which two of these sources of finance would have been most suitable for the fashion
show enterprise. Justify your choice, including why you rejected the other source.
